import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to database
conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-054.sqlite')

# Get table info
table_info = pd.read_sql("PRAGMA table_info(customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis)", conn)
print("Table Structure:")
print(table_info)

# Get basic stats about estimated_customer_ltv
stats = pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as count,
        MIN(estimated_customer_ltv) as min_val,
        MAX(estimated_customer_ltv) as max_val,
        AVG(estimated_customer_ltv) as avg_val
    FROM customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis
""", conn)
print("\nValue Statistics:")
print(stats)

# Sample some records
sample = pd.read_sql("SELECT estimated_customer_ltv FROM customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis LIMIT 5", conn)
print("\nSample Values:")
print(sample)

conn.close()

import sqlite3
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
import pandas as pd

# Set up precision
getcontext().prec = 50

# Connect to database
conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-054.sqlite')

# Engine A - SQL Method
sql_result = pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT printf('%.20f', 
    CAST(SUM(estimated_customer_ltv) AS NUMERIC)) 
    FROM customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis
""", conn)
engine_a = sql_result.iloc[0,0]
print(f"Engine A (SQL) Result: {engine_a}")

# Engine B - Python Method
vals = pd.read_sql("SELECT estimated_customer_ltv FROM customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis", conn)['estimated_customer_ltv']
py_sum = sum(Decimal(str(v)) for v in vals)
engine_b = py_sum.quantize(Decimal('1e-20'))
print(f"Engine B (Python) Result: {engine_b}")

# Compare results
print("\nComparison:")
print(f"Match to 20 decimal places: {engine_a == str(engine_b)[:21]}")
print(f"Full Engine A: {engine_a}")
print(f"Full Engine B: {engine_b}")

conn.close()
